user.title: Connect to ha-todo
user.description: Sign in as a household member. Ask the admin to create an account for Home Assistant, then share each list, collection and tracker with it.

data_description.url: For example https://todo.example.org. Use https - the session cookie is marked Secure and will be dropped over plain http.

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in again
reauth_confirm.description: The password for this account was refused.

error.invalid_auth: That username and password were refused.
error.no_session: Signed in, but the session cookie cannot be used with that address. It is marked Secure, so it is only ever sent over https - use the https:// address rather than http://.

data_description.scan_interval: Each check is one request per shared list and tracker, plus five.

add_item.name: Add chore
add_item.description: Adds a chore to a list shared with this account. Pick the list's sensor as the target.

due_date.name: Due date
due_date.description: A whole day. Stored as the end of that day in the household's timezone, because midnight belongs to the day before.

due_datetime.name: Due date and time
due_datetime.description: A specific time, read as the household's clock.

complete_item.name: Complete chore
complete_item.description: Marks a chore done. The points go to this account, because that is who did it. Pick the list's sensor as the target.

item.name: Chore
item.description: The chore, by description - or by its id, from this sensor's items attribute if two chores share a description.

lapse_item.name: Lapse chore
lapse_item.description: Records that nobody got to a chore. It earns nothing and is not a completion. Pick the list's sensor as the target.

item.name: Chore
item.description: The chore, by description - or by its id, from this sensor's items attribute if two chores share a description.

reopen_item.name: Reopen chore
reopen_item.description: Puts a finished or lapsed chore back. The record is kept and any points are returned. Pick the list's sensor as the target.

item.name: Chore
item.description: The chore, by description - or by its id, from this sensor's items attribute if two chores share a description.

add_collection_entry.name: Add collection entry
add_collection_entry.description: Adds an entry to a collection shared with this account.

tags.name: Tags
tags.description: Free-form tags, which the collection's search reads.

record_tracker_reading.name: Record tracker reading
record_tracker_reading.description: Records a number on a tracker shared with this account. On a tracker kept per member this writes Home Assistant's own series - use a shared tracker per person to record somebody else's numbers.

note.name: Note
note.description: A short note about this reading.

period_start.name: Date
period_start.description: Which day the reading belongs to. Defaults to today in the household's timezone; the server decides which week or month that falls in.
